description: Agent routing configuration for Dom's personal workspace. Personas are wired as real Claude Code subagents in .claude/agents/ — this file is the machine-readable source for gates and routing.

cfo.name: Chief Financial Officer
cfo.delegation_scope: Substantive specialist judgment, existing required domain review, or explicit request; not routine execution, reports or keyword matches alone.

csp.name: Chief Software Programmer
invoke_when: Before architectural changes, an existing compliance gate assigning review to csp, or an explicit request; not routine debugging or multi-file edits alone.

auditor.name: Chief Audit Officer
auditor.special: One bounded risk review; parallel only with an independent required review.
invoke_when: Before direct stored-data writes (backfills, migrations, repairs or column writes), changes to financial/accounting calculations, security/authentication/tenant boundaries, or year-end close; also when explicitly requested. File count alone is not a trigger.

fast_path.description: Main-session execution for routine fixes, documentation/config edits, lookups, reports and tests; file count alone does not require delegation. Required risk reviews and approval gates always take precedence.
criteria: Routine execution, lookup, report, fix or test

lazy_learnings.description: Check learnings file only when needed
check_when: First time entering domain this session
About to perform a write operation
Task matches keywords from past failures

large_transaction.trigger: Payment, transfer, or transaction amount exceeds threshold

audit_policy.description: Risk-triggered review before execution/commit; exception-based logging, never routine success.
audit_policy.trigger: Before direct stored-data writes (backfills, migrations, repairs or column writes), changes to financial/accounting calculations, security/authentication/tenant boundaries, or year-end close; also when explicitly requested. File count alone is not a trigger.

parallel_execution.condition: Only after each agent meets its explicit trigger and the assignments are independent; safe combinations do not authorize spawning.

delegation_policy.additional_reviewers: Only for a distinct required review; no duplicate review of the same question.
delegation_policy.gate_assigned_reviews: A named gate agent retains its required review; csp includes gate-assigned credential/deployment review. The any designation does not itself require an extra agent.
